Matrix-tree differentiation yields Cov(I_e,I_f)=-Kef^2 (e≠f), Var(I_e)=Kee-Kee², hence degree Cov(Du,Dv)=sum shared Kee -sum_{e incident u,f incident v}Kef². Nonadjacent rims have no shared edges and strictly positive Huv spoke-current, hence strict negative. Adjacent rims share one edge; exact cyclic Green recurrences yield Cov=-[57 x_m²-50x_m+11]/2=-57/2(x_m-25/57)²-1/57<0, with x_m=(1+q^m)/(sqrt5(1-q^m)). Hub–rim follows from constant total degree and rotation: -Var(Dhub)/m<0. Induced rim C_m for m>=5 obstructs distance-hereditary property and implies non-real-stability by Cherkashin–Petrov–Prozorov Theorem 1. Bare C_m adjacent covariance (m-4)/m² positive. Independent exact rational grounded-current computation for all distinct degree pairs on m=5..12 verified explicit adjacency and hub formulas; analytic proof covers all m.
